items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: I don't think he would ever have gotten close enough to hear it.

ctx.x: Do you think Karl Marx would have endorsed jazz as a music of the proletariat?
I don't think he would ever have gotten close enough to hear it. I don't think he would have taken the time to listen.
Would you use the word proletariat in regards to music?
